# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and runtime reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 strengthens platform support and fixes reliability issues across native, Android, Linux, and browser workloads. Apple deployment requirements are updated, WebGPU browser packaging is simplified, and several managed and native paths now avoid crashes, leaks, and unnecessary allocations.

## Breaking Changes

- **Apple deployment minimums increased** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp assets now require macOS 11 or later and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14 or later. Update affected application deployment targets before upgrading. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))

## Platform

- **Apple deployment support updated** — Native Apple assets now use consistent macOS 11 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 14 baselines, with managed platform metadata aligned to the native requirements. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebGPU browser builds simplified** — Packages the required emdawnwebgpu C++ support in the native WebAssembly archive, so consumer application links no longer compile that source with their own C or C++ settings. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Windows native dependencies refreshed** — Updates the Windows build toolchain, ANGLE, Windows App SDK, and WebView2 integration used by WinUI, MAUI, and Uno packages. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321), [#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKData string creation is safer and more efficient** — SKData.FromCString now avoids reading past its native buffer and writes directly into SKData; managed image pixel copies also avoid an intermediate allocation when direct raster copying is valid. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429), [#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Linux HarfBuzz loading is isolated** — Bundled HarfBuzz functions bind locally, preventing incompatible system HarfBuzz symbols loaded by GTK from being used with bundled objects. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Rendering and stream lifetime fixes** — Android texture views pace continuous rendering to the display refresh rate, and front-buffered managed streams no longer retain their source unnecessarily. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345), [#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Text shaping reduces transient allocations** — HarfBuzzSharp reuses UTF-32 encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocations while preserving existing decoding behavior. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
